newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Aircraft maker to join Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Aircraft maker to join Bucharest bourse.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Wednesday that state-run aircraft manufacturer Aeroteh SA would join the bourse on Thursday, bringing to 26 the number of listings.
The Bucharest-based Aeroteh will join another 23 stocks on the exchange's second tier. It has a capital of 17.42 billion lei in 697,140 shares with a face value of 25,000 lei each.
Brokers declined to comment on the newcomer, saying they had few details on Aeroteh.
Aeroteh was included in a 1995 mass selloff scheme offering Romanians stakes of up to 60 percent in 4,000 companies in exchange for coupons. Subscription was 30 percent for Aeroteh.
The company's majority stockholder is the State Owernship Fund (FPS) with a 70 percent stake. Private stockholders hold 27.4 percent, with 2.6 percent held by employees.
Bourse activity, which was dull throughout 1996, picked up this year, with more listings and volumes on the rise since early January.
